title: You're My Favorite... Don't Ever Forget That | Destiny 2 The Final Shape Final Mission Cutscene
description: The second of four final cutscenes for The Final Shape, played after the Witness is defeated in the Excision mission.
source_rights_note: Third-party cutscene capture by Swept of Bungie in-engine footage. The uploader's contribution is limited to the capture. Used under Bungie's fan-content forbearance, which is explicitly not permission, is revocable, and permits non-commercial fan creations only. This repository stores metadata and timestamps, never the footage.
